Create Maxar / Vantor API Request with Authentication

Source: R/vantor_api_gettoken.R
create_maxar_request.Rd

Helper function to create an httr2 request with Vantor/Maxar bearer token or API key authentication and built-in retry logic for transient HTTP errors.

Usage

create_maxar_request(url, token = NULL, api_key = NULL, verbose = FALSE)

Arguments

url

Character string. The API endpoint URL.

token

Character string. Optional bearer token (access_token from get_maxar_token()).

api_key

Character string. Optional Maxar/Vantor API key.

verbose

Logical. If TRUE, prints confirmation of the configured request. Defaults to FALSE.

Value

An httr2_request object with authentication headers and retry policies set.

Examples

req <- create_maxar_request(
  "https://api.maxar.com/discovery/v1",
  api_key = "example_key"
)
